body.name: Complete known-J anchor-star recovery margin vector
body.construction: The finite vector \(\mathfrak m(p)\) contains the two cohort shares; every pairwise eigengap \(|\rho_j^d-\rho_k^d|\); the smallest singular values of all anchor-star matrices \(M_{x_0y}^d\) and \(M_{xy_0}^d\), all recovered \(B_x^{d,\mathcal U}\), all \(W_x^d\), all \(C_y^d(C_y^d)^\top\), and all \(C_y^{d,\mathcal V}\); the absolute values of every entry of \(q_{x_0y}^d\) and \(c_x^d\) used in a division; every recovered active mass \(\widehat\alpha_j^d\); and the descending-order label margins for the common untreated signatures. It is evaluated on the \(N_m\)-cell absorption-legal support and lists every denominator, inverse, eigengap, and label margin used by \(\Phi\).
